title: CachingTest LoadMultiWithConfig_race flaky failure on Windows
signature: CachingTest LoadMultiWithConfig_race flaky failure on Windows|Flaky Test
failed_jobs: C++ unit tests / C++ unit tests
root_cause: The CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race test is a well-known intermittent race-condition test in the OpenVINO caching test suite. It exercises concurrent model loading with caching enabled and has a history of sporadic failures on Windows runners. This is the 8th recorded occurrence (7 prior). The specific test variant ByModelName_testCache exercises the ByModelName cache strategy under concurrent load. No code changes in PR #37500 (NPUW LLMInferRequest port map fix) touch the caching subsystem.
reproduction_steps: Run: ov_inference_functional_tests --gtest_filter=CachingTest/CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race/ByModelName_testCache on a Windows runner under concurrent load
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job - this is a known flaky test that typically passes on retry
Consider disabling or marking CachingTest/CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race as flaky in the test suite
Track the issue with a dedicated JIRA ticket to fix the race condition root cause
prevention_strategies: Add test retry logic for known-flaky race-condition tests. Alternatively, stabilize the race by using mock synchronization primitives with deterministic ordering in CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race.
historical_context: This exact test has failed 7 times previously (first seen 2026-07-13, last seen 2026-08-04) with pattern hash 43e136cf67333978. Previous runs: 30928353875, 30904967401, 30891410624, 30540715415, 29813410817, 29341562536, 29234771303.
